title: Building Supervision into Hebbian Plasticity through Spike Agreement
abstract: arXiv:2601.08526v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Supervised learning in spiking neural networks (SNNs) typically requires either gradient-based backpropagation, which sacrifices the Hebbian, spike-driven character of biological plasticity, or reward-modulated Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP), in which class supervision enters only as a scalar gate on an otherwise class-agnostic correlation signal. We propose Supervised Spike Agreement-Dependent Plasticity (Supervised SADP), a gradient-free supervised Hebbian learning algorithm in which class information is embedded directly into the Hebbian plasticity computation rather than introduced through reward modulation. SADP trains the output layer via a supervised Hebbian rule that encodes class labels into output spike patterns, then trains the hidden layer by measuring each hidden neuron's chance-corrected temporal agreement, Cohen's kappa, with the correct-class output spike train produced by the forward pass without grad

translated_title: 通过脉冲一致性将监督信息融入赫布可塑性
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）中的监督学习通常需要以下两种方式之一：要么采用基于梯度的反向传播，但这牺牲了生物可塑性的赫布特性和脉冲驱动特性；要么采用奖励调制的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP），但其中类别监督仅作为标量门控信号作用于本质上与类别无关的相关性信号。我们提出了监督式脉冲一致性依赖可塑性，这是一种无梯度的监督式赫布学习算法，其中类别信息被直接嵌入到赫布可塑性计算中，而非通过奖励调制引入。SADP通过监督式赫布规则训练输出层，将类别标签编码到输出脉冲模式中；随后通过测量每个隐藏神经元与由无梯度前向传播产生的正确类别输出脉冲序列之间的经机会校正的时间一致性（即Cohen's kappa系数）来训练隐藏层。
tldr: 本文提出监督式脉冲一致性依赖可塑性（Supervised SADP），一种无梯度的监督式赫布学习算法，将类别信息直接嵌入赫布可塑性计算中，并利用Cohen's kappa系数度量隐藏神经元与正确类别输出脉冲序列的时间一致性来训练隐藏层。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Supervised Spike Agreement-Dependent Plasticity (Supervised SADP), a gradient-free supervised Hebbian learning algorithm that embeds class information directly into the Hebbian plasticity computation and trains the hidden layer by measuring Cohen's kappa temporal agreement between hidden neurons and the correct-class output spike train.
